description: Espoon joukkoliikennenousut is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Espoon kaupungin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. Daily public transport increases in Espoo in November 2022, 2023 and 2024. The data on the rise of public transport in Espoo are based on HSL's calculations. Rises in bus traffic are collected with the help of a travel card system. Coverage: Espoon kaupungin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. The publisher named on the listing is Espoon kaupungin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. Its keywords include nousijamäärät, public transport, number of passengers, joukkoliikenne. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GPKG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
